class.name: WaterForces
class.brief_description: Buoyancy and drag on a rig's rigid bodies from a [GroundData]'s water field, applied before each physics tick.
class.description: Each body is its collision primitive (a box, a capsule or a sphere in the body's frame) with a volume of its own. From the water at its centre: the submerged share (the surface through the shape's vertical extent), buoyancy (density times gravity times volume times the share, up, at the submerged part's centre), quadratic drag against the velocity relative to the flow (the shape's area across it, times the share; at most what stops the relative motion within the tick) and a spin drag across the long axis. Forces go through the physics server's per-step force.

method.name: add_box
method.description: Adds a body as a box centred at [param center] in its frame.

method.name: add_capsule
method.description: Adds a body as a capsule along its frame's [param axis] (0, 1 or 2), [param height] its total height.

method.name: add_sphere
method.description: Adds a body as a sphere.

method.name: apply
method.description: Applies the water's forces for the coming physics tick and returns the submerged share of the bodies' volume (0 out of the water, after one look at the field around the first body).

method.name: get_submerged
method.description: Returns the last [method apply]'s submerged share.

members.member: The distance from the first body to any part of the rig, for the early out.
